scope.purpose: Map baseline structure, partitions, linings, floors, ceilings, openings, electrical/data, hydraulic/gas, HVAC/exhaust, fire/life-safety, special assemblies, penetration/seal rules and maintenance access to each programmed InterSol space; route unresolved numerical/product/rating choices to explicit evidence gates.

closure_rules: No room may reach design freeze with an undefined boundary, service, fire/life-safety or maintainability state.
No numerical structural, electrical, hydraulic, HVAC, fire, blast, ballistic, product or fastener value may be inferred without evidence/professional design.
H40 and L30 remain interface families, not allowable-load ratings.
All critical penetrations, joints, valves, dampers, traps, junctions and service interfaces must remain inspectable or have a defined removable access assembly.
Rated barriers use complete tested penetration systems; unknown penetration state is prohibited.
Experimental Solar Hull, living, acoustic, lighting or human-factors overlays remain secondary to the baseline safe structure/envelope/services.
Gas remains conditional and is not populated without a process inventory and hazard basis.
Free Flow test enclosures and operational storage are separate qualification families.
state: architecture and assembly families defined; room mapping complete at baseline; deterministic cross-check and evidence-gated numerical/product closure next
